3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:fcb60da3-f2d5.title: BCBA Consultant  - Arizona (Part-Time, Remote)
3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:fcb60da3-f2d5.description: What We're Looking For: We’re expanding our autism services and need Board‑Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) to serve as part‑time consultants. You will help us shape local care models, expand insurance contracts, and if interested, create a launch‑pad to build or grow your own independent practice—without the usual operational headache. Key Responsibilities: - We are looking for around 1 hr commitment per week - Advise on state regulations, cultural nuances, and care‑model innovation. - Advise on policies and outcome metrics to ensure evidence‑based, family‑centered care. - Act as the primary credentialed provider for the group when we are applying to commercial and Medicaid plans in your state. - Use and critique our all‑in‑one tech stack (scheduling, data, EHR, billing) to guide product improvements. - If you wish, start seeing clients on our platform and build your own practice over time (no upfront fees, full ops support). What We Provide: - World‑class operational support so you stay focused on clinical input. - Fully integrated practice‑management suite, payer enrollment team, and rapid‑pay billing. - Access to a nationwide BCBA peer community - Priority eligibility for a full practice‑owner track with Tilly Therapy whenever you’re ready. Ideal Candidate: - Active BCBA license in good standing in Arizona. - License to practice in multiple states a plus - Familiarity with payer credentialing or utilization‑management processes is a plus. - Passion for expanding equitable autism care and experimenting with outcome‑driven models. - Enjoys autonomy and remote, flexible collaboration Compensation Compensation will be $100-150 per hour dependent on experience and geographic location. About 3Y Health At 3Y, we believe BCBAs deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where BCBAs can launch and grow your own ABA practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. What Makes 3Y Health Different? - $0 upfront to join — No fees, no hidden costs. - Earn up to $320,000/year based on your client caseload and schedule. - Concierge assistance with LLC creation, business banking, and liability insurance. - Total flexibility — You choose your hours, clients, and care model. - World-class support — We take care of operations so you can focus on clinical outcomes. - Custom referral support to help you build your preferred caseload. What We Provide Practice Owners: - All-in-one software suite – Includes Practice Management, Scheduling, EHR, Data Collection, Billing, Onboarding, and mobile apps for you, your RBTs, and your clients. - Insurance partnerships – We’re in-network with 100+ payers at high market rates, giving you broad access to patients. - Practice launch support – We’ll help you start your own ABA company if you don’t already have one. - Fast payments – Get paid upfront per session. No more chasing down insurance. - Payroll made easy – We’ll run payroll for you and your RBTs if you’d like.

alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:d1b53083-1.title: GRC Manager
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:d1b53083-1.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) Manager to build, support, and continuously enhance Baseten’s security governance, compliance, and privacy programs. As one of the early members of our security organization, you will play a key role in ensuring our platform meets and exceeds the highest standards for privacy, trust, and regulatory compliance. In this role, you’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, operations, legal, and leadership teams to develop policies, manage audits, and implement controls aligned with frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and FedRAMP. You’ll be instrumental in building scalable processes to manage risk, support customer assurance, and uphold Baseten’s commitment to security and compliance as we grow. RESPONSIBILITIES - Governance & Policy Development: Design, implement, and maintain security governance frameworks, policies, and procedures that align with Baseten’s risk posture and industry best practices. - Risk Management: Build and manage the company-wide risk assessment program, identifying, tracking, and mitigating key security and compliance risks. - Compliance Operations: Lead efforts to achieve and maintain compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701, HIPAA, FedRAMP and other applicable standards and regulations. - Audit & Certification Management: Coordinate external audits and certification processes, ensuring evidence collection, control validation, and remediation plans are executed efficiently. - Third-Party Risk Management: Oversee vendor security assessments and ensure third-party providers meet Baseten’s security and compliance standards. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to embed compliance and risk management into day-to-day operations and technical processes. - Customer Trust & Assurance: Support customer security questionnaires, due diligence efforts, and documentation requests from prospective and existing clients. - Training & Awareness: Develop and deliver security and compliance training to ensure company-wide understanding of key policies and responsibilities. - Continuous Improvement: Stay current on evolving regulatory requirements and lead initiatives to mature our compliance and risk management programs. REQUIREMENTS - 5+ years of experience in GRC, Security Compliance, or Information Security roles, ideally in a SaaS or cloud-native environment. - Strong understanding of security frameworks and standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, and GDPR. - Proven track record managing compliance audits and certification programs end-to-end. - Experience with access management concepts, third-party risk - Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders to implement compliance and security controls. - Excellent organizational, documentation, and communication skills with attention to detail. - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment while maintaining structure and process discipline. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with cloud security compliance in AWS or GCP environments. - Hands-on experience using GRC tools (e.g., Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, Anecdotes). - Understanding of AI/ML security considerations, data privacy, and model governance. - Previous experience building and scaling compliance programs

compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.title: Endoscopy Technician
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Eastgate Surgery Center Location: Eastgate Surgery Center Address: 4415 Aicholtz Road A, Cincinnati, OH 45245 Eastgate Surgery Center is an ambulatory surgery center located in Cincinnati, Ohio. With four procedure rooms, the center provides high-quality, cost-effective outpatient surgical and procedural care primarily for GI and Endoscopies. Owned and operated in partnership with BSMH and Gastro Health, Eastgate Surgery Center combines advanced technology with compassionate, patient-centered care in a convenient setting. Role Summary The Endoscopy Technician is responsible for the cleaning, high-level disinfection, maintenance, and inventory control of endoscopic instruments, equipment, and reusable medical supplies in accordance with nationally recognized standards, regulatory requirements, and center policies to support safe, high-quality patient care. Hours: Monday- Friday, 6:00 AM - 4:00 PM What You’ll Do • Perform cleaning, inspection, and high-level disinfection of endoscopic instruments and equipment • Demonstrate knowledge of reprocessing equipment and proper use within the processing area • Use, monitor, and document chemical disinfectants according to policy and manufacturer guidelines • Follow established protocols for decontaminating, cleaning, flushing, and disinfecting endoscopic equipment • Inspect instruments and equipment for functionality and integrity • Track loaned instruments and equipment to ensure completeness and timely return • Maintain accurate documentation related to reprocessing and chemical monitoring • Assist in maintaining inventory of endoscopy supplies and equipment • Follow all safety, infection control, and regulatory requirements • Perform other duties as assigned What You’ll Bring • High school diploma or equivalent required • Knowledge of endoscopy reprocessing and high-level disinfection standards required. • Ability to follow detailed procedures and maintain accurate records • Strong attention to detail and commitment to patient safety • Prior healthcare, endoscopy, or sterile processing experience preferred Physical & Work Environment Requirements - Frequent standing, walking, and patient-care activities - Ability to lift/move up to 30 lbs (occasionally up to 40 lbs; rarely up to 100 lbs) - Regular interaction with patients of varying ages in a fast-paced clinical environment - Exposure to bloodborne pathogens, and chemical hazards consistent with the surgical setting Compensation & Benefits - Competitive hourly rate (based on experience and qualifications) - Healthcare benefits package - 401(k) with company match - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Supportive, collaborative, and growing environment

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:60.title: Senior Substation Engineer
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:60.description: We understand that finding the right place to work isn't easy. At Beta Engineering, we believe in cultivating a team that wins together and takes on the most challenging projects in the high-voltage industry. We engineer, procure, and construct (EPC) projects for a variety of customers, including those in the utility, industrial, and renewable energy markets. Our work includes substations, transmission lines and more. We help our customers achieve their goals of creating a stronger power grid by reducing risks and identifying innovative solutions for their project challenges. Our Purpose: We pursue that which challenges us, growing our community to provide critical, creative solutions that achieve extraordinary results. Our Values: We do what we say, we turn challenges into success and we win together. Beta Engineering is currently looking for a Substation Engineer to join their team. Substation Engineers (SE) are responsible for the design, interpretation, application and documentation of drawings and calculations pertaining to the physical design of a substation. Substation Engineers are tasked with ensuring that designs, and their applications, are completed to code and standards set forth by the appropriate authoritative bodies. In addition, SE’s are required to work with customer representatives, Project Management Teams and other engineering disciplines to ensure designs meet appropriate specifications and requirements. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: • Checks conduit, grounding, control shelter, electrical arrangements, outdoor lighting and equipment vendor design packages. • Performs and checks grounding calculations, conduit fill calculations, pulling tension calculations, vehicle tracking calculations, outdoor lighting calculations, lightning protection designs calculations, substation Sag-10 calculations, flexible jumper calculations, bus design calculations, arc-flash calculations, insulation coordination calculations, and underground ampacity calculations • Creates and checks material list descriptions for all major equipment and minor substation material. • Demonstrates integrity and ethics in all client relationships and communications. • Answers technical questions posed by construction managers, field staff, project managers, customers and their representatives. • Recognize and recommend methods to improve customer’s experience. • Perform other studies as able and required. • Travels periodically to both customer offices for project meetings and to job sites for construction visits and testing • Manages day-to-day activities of schedule and design of projects assigned to them • Coordinates and problem solves between design teams and departments EXPECTATIONS: • Performs quality work within deadlines with or without direct supervision. • Interacts professionally with other employees and customers. • Works effectively as a team contributor on all assigned projects. • Communicates regularly with supervisor regarding designs, concerns, studies or tests • Desire to participate in continued education and training • Occasional overnight travel to active job sites • Must have clean driving record as use of company vehicles is a requirement of position • Adhere to and practice the Beta core competencies and Beta principle • Maintains check print set of all work they perform • Utilizes the department resources in an effective manner to get all work accomplished on time and correctly EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: • Bachelor degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Civil Engineering. • 5 plus years of experience in the physical design of high voltage substations is required • PE license is required • Strong background in Microsoft Word, Mathcad, Excel, and PowerPoint required; strong verbal and written communication skills are required. • Knowledge of all or some of the following applications are preferred: AutoCAD, CDEGS grounding software, CYMCAP, LitePro, FEAP, Southwire SAG/Ten, Alcoa

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:b20.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Kitchen Assistant at Sur La Table, you play a key role in inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. With a passion for cooking, hospitality, and teamwork, the Kitchen Assistant supports the chefs to ensure smooth class operations and a #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. You’ll help bring culinary dreams to life by supporting our chefs, engaging with guests, and ensuring a clean, well-organized kitchen environment. Sales & Business Performance · Assist chefs with class execution that drives repeat visits and positive customer feedback · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:37454933-e6ae-4a2.description: ABOUT THE JOB Founding go-to-market role at a fast growing, venture-backed B2B AI startup. Own our growth engine end-to-end. COMPANY OVERVIEW Lenders spend over $24B every year hiring agents to perform manual, repetitive servicing work. Existing AI solutions try to automate this, but they treat regulatory guardrails as an afterthought - meaning they can’t guarantee compliance and can’t be trusted with critical servicing workflows. Kato takes a different approach. Regulations aren’t an afterthought - they’re the foundation. We start with a regulatory rules system and layer an AI decision engine on top. With this architecture, we’re building an AI-powered servicing platform that automates critical workflows across every channel with full compliance and best-in-class recoveries. We are starting today with a compliance first Voice AI agent that handles outbound and inbound loan servicing calls. We have grown ARR 6x this year and are already in production with major names in the fintech lending space like Bilt Rewards https://biltrewards.com/, Bluevine https://www.bluevine.com/ and Parafin https://www.parafin.com/. Kato is founded by a team with deep operating expertise in financial services and software engineering: - Pratik Risbud https://www.linkedin.com/in/pratikrisbud/ (CEO/Co-Founder): Former Investment Banker at Goldman Sachs and led Credit/Operations at Brex - David Zhu https://www.linkedin.com/in/david-y-zhu/ (CTO/Co-Founder): Former Software Engineer at Google and Engineering Manager at Brex Kato is backed by institutional capital from Pear VC and angel investors from top tech companies such as Brex, Bridge, and Square. THE ROLE We already know how to find and close customers. We are now hiring our Founding GTM Operator: a generalist who owns demand generation and turns our go-to-market into a repeatable growth engine. This is one of the most critical hires at Kato and you'll work directly with the CEO. On the outbound and conference side, that means getting sharper and more sophisticated about how we find customers - tracking the right buying signals, testing new plays, and expanding our conference presence. And on the brand side, it’s wide open. We want to turn Kato into a household name in the lending space. You'll own building our presence from scratch: events, webinars, LinkedIn posts, newsletters, blogs. When someone in this industry thinks about AI for servicing & collections, we want them to think of Kato first. Across both, we don't just want someone who can run the motion - we want someone who builds the system behind it, using AI and automation to take out as much manual work as possible.
